body:
Closes #184. Includes the independently reviewed #187 development-watch fix; PR #190 has no separate CI run.

The geographic game prepares the approved coastline and region drawing in a Worker before mounting. Paint and hit testing share the drawing; cancelled or failed loads preserve the prior match. The package identifies the owner-approved 0.1.0 early playable scope.

**Release acceptance is blocked.** The current exact-output performance correction has not received an independent approving review or green final-head CI. No 0.1.0 tag/release exists. This PR remains draft.

Scope: geographic host/map/file-load activation; 0.1.0 metadata/play instructions; exact-output pure drawing-provider optimization; reviewed Vite exclusion for the repository’s retained .cache tree and its harness guard; preserved provenance and evidence. Gameplay, saves, RNG, card policy, geometry constants/version and five-second UI assertions remain unchanged.

Current adopted source/proof checkpoint: cb8e320b73b0f134ac8c73ba210b554211b0a0ad. Complete result/evidence commit: ead258b505c8e27a92830f8d49b0945025632327.

Fresh validation on that source:
```
python3 docs/prototypes/new-game/T75/production/verify-adoption.py
  exit 0; 5.057s; zero mismatches
npm test
  exit 0; 818/818 Vitest across 60 files + 9/9 harness; 91.277s
node docs/prototypes/playable/acceptance.mjs <owned-extraction>
  exit 0; typecheck/build/package; 10 files, 9 checksums, 4 HTTP paths; 5.739s
13 affected extracted browser specs, both desktop sizes, workers=2, retries=0
  exit 1; 165 passed / 1 failed of 166; 639.940s
```
The failure is the 1280×800 compact-panels geographic computer-phase case: the original 5000ms poll still sees the old load widget connected. It fails on initial cold load, before panel-bounds assertions. Its specific cause is unproven; resumed work is performing one bounded instrumented diagnostic on the existing artifact, not retrying acceptance or CI.

[Full current report and retained raw results](https://github.com/diegoami/malpaco/blob/ead258b505c8e27a92830f8d49b0945025632327/docs/prototypes/new-game/T75/corrections/20261019/adoption/REPORT.md).

Evidence limitation (#189): the prior driver omitted two screenshot output variables. Current ignored fallback screenshots are retained, but earlier fixed compact screenshot bytes may have been overwritten; their preservation is unproven. This limitation is separate from verified restoration of 15,071 inventoried files. Future browser work backs up ignored outputs and uses unique owned destinations.

Historical results remain separate: the old provider had 166/166 extracted preflight passes and an independent Kimi review, then final CI39168930877 failed (289/344 source browser checks passed; packaging/extracted stage skipped). That review does not cover the corrected provider. Three corrected representative real-Worker controls passed with exact input/output equality; they do not waive the current 165/166 result. No unchanged CI rerun occurred.

The owner approved the unchanged drawing appearance/pacing in comment6255060460. Final functional acceptance, separately authorized correction review, one combined exact-head green CI, fresh merge key, exact tested artifact audit and publication gates remain binding. Broader generation #181 stays after0.1.x.

Docs: README.md, docs/play.md, tools/release/PLAY.md, docs/spike.md and T75 production/correction reports and proofs. All original worktrees/evidence remain retained. The current localhost4187/Windows preview is the earlier approved build, not the corrected release artifact.
